ac1_ac2_decision.reasoning: 1) Defect is real, independently reproduced by me (not trusted from any report), and genuinely pre-existing (confirmed on origin/main). 2) Not fixable within this test-execution-only requirement's scope. 3) The gap was not silently absorbed as a pass -- both scenarios were genuinely truncated, and the failure itself is asserted as the real, closed disposition, satisfying AC5 even where AC1/AC2's fuller claims are honestly reported unverified. 4) Three-level disclosure (scenario YAML headers, test file comments, step-02a result.issues) is genuinely internally consistent, independently re-checked by me. 5) Discovering this defect is exactly the class of correctness-gate finding S7 exists to produce -- treating that discovery as grounds for FAIL would penalize the run for doing its job. A genuine FAIL would require: the defect being fixable in-scope and left unfixed, inconsistent/fabricated disclosure, or the truncated tests silently claiming success past the failure point -- none of which hold.
